ANALYTIC.condition_number: 2-norm of regularized normal matrix; full SVD charged
ANALYTIC.solver: full augmented normal matrix, Cholesky solve

BP.early_stop: pre-update gradient infinity norm <= 1e-7; L-BFGS returns without an update at that point

HYBRID.solver: independent same ridge solve followed by supervised development selection

algorithms.budget: per-arm CPU for construction, optimizer setup, all attempted updates and cached-development checks; atomic overrun is reported
algorithms.objective: mean over examples AND classes of squared signed-onehot error + ridge * sum(weight**2)
algorithms.old_retention: aggregate old-development accuracy and Brier gates; worst-source accuracy is reported, not guaranteed
algorithms.selection: lowest new-development unregularized signed-target MSE among old-retention-eligible candidates and KEEP
algorithms.shared_cost: checkpoint loading, data generation, complete frozen feature extraction and cache IO are charged equally to all five arms
algorithms.working_dtype: float64; each evaluated/saved candidate is cast to parent parameter dtype

claim_scope:
Five head-only adaptation arms with sealed, separately executed final tests.

All methods start from the same selected, independently trained checkpoint.
They receive identical frozen final features and target conventions. Supervised
ridge and its development-selected blends are explicitly not strict WSP.
This experiment tests readout adaptation, not replacement of representation
learning or end-to-end pretraining by a weight program.

editing.objective: mean squared error to common signed one-hot targets plus ridge on weight
